result.topic_en: Gauss writes the hypergeometric series as {α,β,n}, lists contiguous relations among such series, states the hypergeometric differential equation, and transforms it by the substitutions x = t/(t−1) and x = 4t/(1+t)^2.
result.transcription:
224 Mo-
natt. [?] Sell. [?] Litt. Ff. [?]

Es sey $1+\frac{\alpha\beta}{1.n}x+\frac{\alpha.\alpha+1.\beta.\beta+1}{1.2.n.n+1}xx+\ldots=\{\alpha,\beta,n\}=P$

1) $\{\alpha,\beta,n+1\}=\{\alpha,\beta,n\}-\frac{\alpha\beta x}{n.n+1}\{\alpha+1,\beta+1,n+2\}$
2) $\{\alpha,\beta+1,n\}=\{\alpha,\beta,n\}+\frac{\alpha x}{n}\{\alpha+1,\beta+1,n+1\}$
3) $\{\alpha,\beta+1,n+1\}=\{\alpha,\beta,n\}+\frac{\alpha(n-\beta)x}{n.n+1}\{\alpha+1,\beta+1,n+2\}$
also
4) $(n-\beta)\{\alpha,\beta,n+1\}+\beta\{\alpha,\beta+1,{+n+1+}\}=n\{\alpha,\beta,n\}$
5. $\{\alpha,\beta+1,n\}=\{\alpha+1,\beta,n\}+\frac{(\alpha-\beta)x}{n}\{\alpha+1,\beta+1,n+1\}$
[-6. $\beta(n-\alpha)\{\alpha,\beta+1\}\ldots$-]
6. $\beta\{\alpha,\beta+1,n\}=\alpha(\alpha+1,\beta,n)-(\alpha-\beta)\{\alpha,\beta,n\}$ gut [?]

methods.what: Definition of the hypergeometric series notation {α,β,n}
Contiguous relation shifting β and n together

Three-term relation among contiguous functions in α and β
Hypergeometric differential equation in general differential form, with x not taken as the independent variable
Change of variable x = t/(t−1) in the hypergeometric equation
Change of variable x = 4t/(1+t)^2 (quadratic transformation) in the hypergeometric equation
